packages.headline: 20 Years of Gears

sources.label: Xbox Wire
sources.evidenceText:
SummaryGears of War celebrates 20 years with a special anniversary event in Gears of War: E-Day, honoring two decades of brotherhood, community, and Gears of War celebrates 20 years with a special anniversary event in Gears of War: E-Day, honoring two decades of brotherhood, community, and unforgettable memories.
It’s hard to believe that 20 years ago, Gears of War launched on XBOX 360 and introduced the world to Marcus Fenix, Dominic Santiago, and the genius of putting a chainsaw on a gun.
We’ve released new games, introduced new characters and enemies, and welcomed millions of players into the world of Gears. But when we think about what makes this franchise special, it’s not just the games or the stories we’ve told. It’s the people who have made Gears of War part of their lives.
Over the years, we’ve heard some incredible stories from our fans. Stories of friendships that started in multiplayer lobbies and have lasted for decades. Of campaign playthroughs with fathers or brothers, or groups of friends who made playing Horde together a weekly tradition. Soldiers that have played during military deployments and couples who met playing Gears, fell in love, and eventually got married. Not bad for a game about chainsawing monsters.
And then there are the stories that hit a little harder. Fans who have shared how Gears helped them through a dark and difficult time, whether it was dealing with loss, feeling isolated, or just needing a few hours with Delta Squad to forget about everything else going on in their lives. Sometimes a familiar game and a few friends on the other end of a headset can make a real difference.
We’ve always talked about Gears being a franchise built on brotherhood, loyalty, and having each other’s backs. It’s what makes the relationship between Marcus, Dom and the rest of the Gears so important, and it’s been at the heart of the series since the beginning.
Thank you for making Gears part of your lives, and for letting us be a small part of yours.
To celebrate our 20 th Anniversary, this week we kicked off a 2-week anniversary event in Gears of War: E-Day featuring limited time modes and new rewards. In Versus, play Guardian, where only one leader makes it out alive. And in Horde Siege, try out the For the Queen mode, where the supply cache is disabled, leaving you and the squad to rely on your loadouts.
Tomorrow is the exact date of our anniversary and to celebrate we’re giving away RAAM as a multiplayer character to every Gears of War: E-Day player as a free gift. Just login to claim him instantly.
Since then, a lot has happened.

packages.headline: Cat-Astrophy: How a Build Can Change Every Expedition

sources.label: Xbox Wire
sources.evidenceText:
SummaryHow every expedition can lead to a different build.Change the way you fight through module synergies and directional attacks.Every build creates a How specific player builds can customize gameplay in Cat-Astrophy.
Cat-Astrophy: How a Build Can Change Every Expedition
When I enter a new expedition in Cat-Astrophy , I don’t start with a fixed build that I have to repeat. I start with a question: what kind of Polo am I going to build this time? That idea is at the core of the module system, and it’s why two runs can take me down completely different paths, even when I return to a planet I already know.
During each run, I find modules that can modify specific abilities, stats, or systems. Some improve close-range combat, while others favour mobility, defence, or a more strategic approach. The key is that I don’t have to decide everything before I start: the build takes shape through what I find, what I keep, and how I react to each situation.
The most interesting part comes when modules stop working as isolated pieces. Some can evolve, while others hide synergies that only become apparent when combined. An upgrade that seems simple on its own can end up changing the way I move, attack, or navigate a room. At that point, the expedition becomes more than a succession of fights. It becomes an experiment: I try a combination, see what it does, and decide whether it’s worth building around.
The same principle extends to combat. Cat-Astrophy uses directional attacks that can be customized for forward, upward, and downward strikes. Each direction has different variants and can create synergies with my modules. On top of that, fatigue builds up as you chain attacks together, so maintaining a combo isn’t simply about using the same attack over and over. You have to decide when to keep pushing and when to stop and regain control of the situation. The result is a system that rewards precision and adaptation rather than relying on a single optimal combination.
Route selection is also part of the build. Each planet has different mechanics, enemies, and rewards, and you can choose their order from the ship that serves as your central hub. One route might favour an offensive build, while another could work better with a setup focused on survival or mobility. At the same time, rooms don’t follow a single path: you  can encounter combat, parkour sections, events, shops, and minibosses, and decide how far you want to deviate from your route to look for a reward.
And even when an expedition ends with Polo’s death, not everything resets. The Star Fragments you collect can be used to unlock permanent upgrades, new options, and new routes for future runs. You can also discover memory fragments that gradually reveal Polo’s past and the truth behind his abduction. This gives every attempt two layers of progression: the build you’re creating now and the possibilities you’re unlocking for later.
That’s why there is no single “correct” build in Cat-Astrophy . You can prioritise fast attacks and combos, look for a more durable setup, or focus on mobility. Even the same planet can feel different when you arrive with a different combination of modules, a different route, and a different approach to combat. The reward isn’t just finding a powerful upgrade, but understanding why it works and what other decisions it can unlock.

packages.headline: Hozy brings calm, tactile home restoration to PS5 on November 9

sources.label: PlayStation Blog
sources.evidenceText:
Are you ready to meet your new cozy favourite?
Hozy brings calm, tactile home restoration to PS5 on November 9
That’s exactly what we wanted to capture in Hozy – a cozy, tactile and stress-free home restoration game that is coming to PlayStation 5 on November 9.
Hozy is a game where you can completely unwind. There are no timers, no scores and no pressure.
Each level in Hozy features a space with its own atmosphere and story. Your first job is to tidy it up and renovate it. Then furnish it using the sets of furniture and décor provided. Don’t worry about being overwhelmed with an endless catalogue – each level features a carefully curated set of items you’ll need so that the end result always looks worthy of the interior design magazine.
To help you tackle the tasks of refurbishing the rooms with ease, you’ll have access to an array of tools: from a simple mop to a crowbar. We all know what it’s like to mop the floors… But in Hozy, even this is a real pleasure. We’ve done our best to ensure that using each tool brings nothing but joy.
Every surface, every object and instrument has its own unique sound. And the music changes dynamically as you progress through the level – we recommend playing with headphones or a home cinema system to fully appreciate the sounds of the world around you.
This is something we’re particularly proud of. When we first started developing Hozy, our main aim was to make using the instruments as enjoyable and responsive as possible. And the DualSense wireless controller is simply perfect for complementing and enhancing that experience.
Once you’ve completed the Hozy storyline, comprising nine unique levels, your journey into the world of cosiness isn’t over yet. Come back to the houses you’ve already restored to discover… new versions of the previous rooms. The ‘Game+’ mode will help you look at these rooms in a new light (literally) – now you can switch between day and night, as well as furnish rooms with different sets of furniture. Some of them will change beyond recognition.
Imagine actually enjoying cleaning your house or ripping out old tiles. Unhinged, isn’t it?
You put on your favourite music and open the windows to let the fresh air in. The dust disappears, the floor begins to shine with every sweep of the mop, and the rooms start to transform into cozy, welcoming spaces. There’s something incredibly satisfying about seeing it all come together, one step at a time.

packages.headline: EAを買収したサウジ系ファンドなどの、次なる狙いはゲームエンジン「Unity」か。評価額約4兆円で買収協議中との報道

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
Silver LakeとPIFを含む投資家コンソーシアムが、Unity Softwareの買収に向けて協議をおこなっているという。
EAを買収したサウジ系ファンドなどの、次なる狙いはゲームエンジン「Unity」か。評価額約4兆円で買収協議中との報道
Silver LakeとPIFを含む投資家コンソーシアムが、Unity Software（以下、Unity）の買収に向けて協議をおこなっているという。Silver LakeとPIFは、先日Electronic Artsの買収を完了させたコンソーシアムの一員だ。匿名の関係者の証言として海外メディア Reuters が報じている。
Reutersが報じるところによると、PIFとSilver Lakeを含むコンソーシアムが、先日Unity Softwareの買収に向けて同社と協議をおこなったという。Unity SoftwareはゲームエンジンUnityの開発を手がけるソフトウェア企業だ。2004年にデンマークで設立され、現在はアメリカ・サンフランシスコに本社を置いている。2020年に上場しており、本稿執筆時点での時価総額は約215億ドル（約3兆2000億円）である。
そして買収を提案しているPIFはサウジアラビアの政府系ファンドで、Silver Lakeは米国のプライベートエクイティ企業だ。両社を含むコンソーシアムは、Electronic Artsの株式の100%を総額約550億ドル（約8兆8000億円）にて取得。今年の8月に正式に買収を完了させている。なお、Silver LakeはすでにUnityの株式を約8％所有する主要株主であり、Silver LakeのCEOであるEgon Durban氏は、Unityの取締役も務めている。
そのPIFとSilver Lakeは、現在Unityについて約250億ドル（約3兆8000億円）の評価額を下しており、同社の買収に向けて接触しているとのこと。関係者によると、Unity側は選択肢を検討している段階であり、投資銀行などと相談をおこなっているという。
Our Q3 performance was our strongest ever, with strategic revenue growing 59% year-over-year and Unity delivering our first-ever GAAP profitable quarter since our IPO. We are seeing the compounding impact of our flywheel strategy: more creators make more games on our platform,… pic.twitter.com/mMEzFP2Guc
Unity Softwareは11月5日に2026年第3四半期の決算を発表しており、それによると戦略的収益は前年同期比59%増の約6億ドル（約900億円）を記録。純利益は約1億2000万ドル（約180億円）となり、上場以来初となる黒字決算の達成を報告した。好調の要因としては、ゲームに特化したAI駆動型広告エンジン「Unity Vector」が業績を牽引しているとのこと。第4四半期も好調の決算が見込めるとしている。なお今回報じられた買収を巡る協議は、決算発表の数週間前におこなわれたとされる。

GTA 6 is shaping up to be one of the biggest pop culture moments in history, and perhaps the biggest video game launch of all time. With this in mind, it’s no surprise that oodles of gamers are planning to call out of work to play it, with estimates showing a 17% increase in time-off requests for its launch date on November 19.
Bildungsurlaub, Germany's legally mandated paid learning leave for certified training courses, is offering a state-funded educational course on storytelling in video games that would give gamers three days off to play GTA 6 from November 18 - 20. Titled ‘Open World Games: Lessons from a Digital World,’ this program is open to 60 participants, letting them use this paid leave to “explore storytelling, digital culture, and collaboration through open-world gaming,” as explained in a press release shared with IGN.
Are You Taking Time Off For GTA 6's Release?
Germany isn't the only country getting ahead of the GTA 6 employment crater; Australia's workplace regulator put out a helpful graphic informing workers of their paid leave rights ahead of the game's launch. And in July, a flyer from the 9th Engineer Battalion in Fort Stewart, Georgia went viral for offering recruits a four-day pass to play GTA 6 with a “special reenlistment incentive."
We at IGN even polled our readers to see how many of you are planning to take time off work to play the game, and the results were surprisingly split down the middle. GTA 6 launches November 19 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox X/S.
This certified learning course lets employees take three days from their jobs without putting their livelihoods on the line.
This trend isn’t limited to the US, either, as a fair amount of fans across the globe will also be staying home to play. Luckily, fans in Germany literally have legal protections that will allow them to do this without putting their jobs on the line.

河出書房新社は11月6日、岡一秀氏が手がけるビジュアルノベルゲーム『ナツノカナタ ―PROLOGUE―』を発表した。対応プラットフォームはPC（Steam）で、12月15日に無料にて配信予定。
本作は、終末世界アドベンチャーゲーム『ナツノカナタ』を原作に、開発者の岡氏自ら執筆した小説「ナツノカナタ」が12月15日に刊行されることを記念して制作された作品だ。
『ナツノカナタ ―PROLOGUE―』は、小説「ナツノカナタ」の冒頭部分が収録され、ビジュアルノベル形式にてプレイできる作品だ。主人公の栞（しおり）は、祖母の遺品であるPCを立ち上げてみたところ、謎の病が流行し荒廃した異世界と繋がる。栞は、そこでナツノやアカネ、イツカという名の少女と出会い、画面越しに交流しながら、謎の病に苦しみながら旅をする彼女たちを救おうと奮闘することになる。
原作である終末世界アドベンチャーゲーム『ナツノカナタ』は、PC（Steam）向けにフリーゲームとして2021年8月に早期アクセス配信され、2022年8月に正式リリース。Steamのユーザーレビューにて、本稿執筆時点で約910件のうち94%が好評とする「非常に好評」ステータスを獲得するなど高い評価を獲得。その後2024年には、ストーリーやキャラクターなどを追加し、Unityで作り直した完全版『ナツノカナタ beyond』もリリースされた。
開発者の岡一秀氏は、その後『ムーンレスムーン』や『ガールズメイドプディング』『プラトニカ・スペース』などのアドベンチャーゲームを手がけ、高評価を連発。その一方で、『ナツノカナタ』を原作とする小説を自ら執筆し、同名の「ナツノカナタ」として刊行される運びとなった。小説では、衝撃の真実がラストに待っているという。
なお、小説「ナツノカナタ」も河出書房新社から12月15日に出版される予定だ。本著について、人気アドベンチャーゲーム『都市伝説解体センター』の開発元・墓場文庫のグラフィッカー/デザイナーであるハフハフ・おでーん氏は、「インディーゲームという枠組みを軽やかに超える才能に、同業者として激しく嫉妬すると同時に、彼の紡ぎ出す物語を心から愛してしまう。憎い」とのコメントを寄せている。

packages.headline: Report: Silver Lake and the Saudi Arabia PIF hold talks with Unity to explore acquisition

sources.label: Game Developer
sources.evidenceText:
The investment partners recently acquired Electronic Arts and are now reportedly turning their gaze toward software engine Unity.
Report: Silver Lake and the Saudi Arabia PIF hold talks with Unity to explore acquisition
Unity Software, the company behind the Unity game engine, is in conversations with Silver Lake and the Saudi Arabia Private Investment Fund, according to new reporting from Reuters . Both Silver Lake and the PIF just recently finalized an acquisition of Electronic Arts, taking the company private in a leveraged buyout.
The Reuters story states that a consortium of investors are involved, with the biggest being Silver Lake—owned by United States President Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner—and Saudi Arabia's Private Investment Fund, which has been investing in numerous video game and technology companies internationally. Silver Lake already owns eight percent of Unity, but Reuters reports that PIF approached both Unity and the investment firm to make an offer for a full buyout.
The sources for the Reuters report also state that the deal would take the form of a leveraged buyout, much like the Electronic Arts deal which purchased the company with funds that would need to be recouped by its operating profit. While not being the record-breaking numbers the EA acquisition boasted, this would still be one of the biggest leveraged buyouts in history.
Related: Nintendo confident in memory supply in new financial report
Unity's game engine is used, by their own accounting, in over half of all mobile games and a large proportion of console and PC games. Scopely, which is already owned by the PIF and Silver Lake among others, uses it to power titles like Pokémon Go and Monopoly Go .
Unity has expanded to an AI-prominent structure, recently launching a prompt-based tool in collaboration with Google to create games entirely from user prompts called Unity Spark.

「ExileCon 2026」では、『Path of Exile 2』正式リリースで追加されるさらなる新要素が発表された。既報では新たなクラスとして「デュエリスト」および新武器である「剣」の登場が発表されていた。そして本日、さらなる新クラス「シャドウ」とそのアセンダンシークラスである「アサシン」「インフィルトレーター」、そして新武器である「短剣」の実装が明らかになった。なお、先日公開された「 闇となれ | Path of Exile 2 正式リリースティーザー 」ではシャドウの実装が噂されていた。
ステージ上では、ジョナサン氏と共に本作のディレクターを務めるマーク・ロバーツ氏がシャドウの実機プレイも披露。実機プレイでは高い機動力でフィールドを駆け巡る短剣を用いた攻撃のほか、火や毒といった効果を放つトラップを投擲する攻撃が確認できた。さらに「ブレードヴォーテックス（BLADE VORTEX）」「ヴァイパーストライク（Viper Strike）」など、『Path of Exile』に登場したスキルも本作へ新たに実装されるようだ。さらに、自身の影を生み出して一緒に攻撃する、あるいは爆発させるようなアクションも確認でき、実装前の今からさまざまなビルドを想像させてくれるクラスとなっている。

そして、本作の正式リリースに伴い、現在はACT4とその後の幕間まで描かれているキャンペーンにACT5および6が追加される。「オリアス」へと向かう手前で足止めさせられていた物語がいよいよ次のフェーズへと進み、『Path of Exile 2』全編を通して描かれる「黄昏の教団」と「魔獣」の戦いに決着がつく模様だ。
